mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( bt.`name` ) AS tariffItemName FROM base_tariff bt WHERE FIND_IN_SET( bt.id, #{ids} )

select bt.id, bt.tariff_category_id as tariffCategoryId, btc.`name` as tariffCategoryName, btc.number as tariffCategoryNumber, bt.item_number as itemNumber, bt.`name`, bt.pinyin, bt.english_name as englishName, bt.unit, bt.price, bt.inservice from base_tariff bt left join base_tariff_category btc on bt.tariff_category_id = btc.id where bt.id = #{id}
select id, tariff_category_id as tariffCategoryId, item_number as itemNumber, `name` from base_tariff_view
